image(myxoec_sscg, model = list(r = 1, s = 12, k = 7), column = 2, key = FALSE, layout = c(1,1), col = "green")

Sorry I am not more well versed in my R usage. I am working on honing in my skills and applying them to these workflows. I really appreciate any help, and again thanks you for all of your work and help.
